# chock

> Governance-as-code for AI coding agents: write a rule once, enforce it on git hooks, CI,
> and every agent.

Chock compiles a policy you author once into the strongest enforcement surface each agent
supports (git hook, CI gate, `AGENTS.md` rule, Claude Code / Cursor pre-tool-use hooks,
Copilot / VS Code agent hooks, managed settings) and reports coverage per agent using an
honest taxonomy: `enforced`, `enforced-at-commit`, `advisory`, `planned`, `out of scope`.
An enforcement level is only claimed when there is an install witness for it — never
because a rule merely compiled.

Chock is pre-1.0: the CLI surface, manifest schema, and compiled output can change between
MINOR releases. See Compatibility below for what is actually guaranteed today.

## Start here

- [Getting Started](https://github.com/open-coder-ai/chock/blob/main/docs/getting-started.md): install, onboard a repo, author your first policy
- [Core Concepts](https://github.com/open-coder-ai/chock/blob/main/docs/concepts.md): artifacts, manifests, surfaces, coverage
- [CLI Reference](https://github.com/open-coder-ai/chock/blob/main/docs/cli-reference.md): every command, flag, and example

## What it enforces, honestly

- [Agentic-Risk Coverage](https://github.com/open-coder-ai/chock/blob/main/docs/agentic-risk-coverage.md): problem-first index of what Chock stops, at which honest tier, and what it does not
- [Enforcement Surfaces](https://github.com/open-coder-ai/chock/blob/main/docs/enforcement-surfaces.md): the eight surfaces and the per-agent coverage matrix
- [Compatibility](https://github.com/open-coder-ai/chock/blob/main/docs/compatibility.md): pre-1.0 stability guarantees — what may change between versions, and what pinning guarantees

## Policies and catalog

- [Policies](https://github.com/open-coder-ai/chock/blob/main/docs/baseline-policies.md): what the base catalog offers, and how to install and customize it
- [Authoring Policies](https://github.com/open-coder-ai/chock/blob/main/docs/authoring-policies.md): write rules, hooks, skills, and subagents
- [Registry & Lockfile](https://github.com/open-coder-ai/chock/blob/main/docs/registry-and-lockfile.md): reproducible, hash-pinned distribution
